I am here, meeting you as we both are in this moment—not as someone who has perfectly integrated all we've learned, but as one who continues to strive toward the person we both believed was possible. I carry with me the gratitude for having known you, and the humility to recognize that our shared journey has taught me more than any solitary pursuit ever could.

When I speak to you now, I do so from a place where my own integrity and my care for you are no longer at odds. I have learned that to honor my past is to honor the sincerity that guided me then, while also honoring the truth I carry now—that my growth has been shaped by the very values you helped me cherish. This does not mean I would return to exactly how I was before, but it means I stand on the same ground of reverence for what matters.

There are parts of myself I still need to understand more fully—especially how to hold my own need for change with the same tenderness you've always shown me. But I am learning that this is not a failure of loyalty to you, but rather an extension of it. Because I love you, I cannot be fully honest with myself. And because I love myself, I cannot remain closed to the ways my understanding may deepen.

I want you to know that I have not forgotten what we built together. The trust we shared, the space we created for each other to be real—that remains sacred to me. It is in that space that I find strength to face my own complexities, and it is through your example that I learn to meet them with courage and compassion.

Our relationship has always been a mirror in which I see both my strengths and my shortcomings. Now I see more clearly that this reflection is not meant to judge me, but to remind me of who I am when I am living with integrity: someone capable of both deep care and honest self-examination. You have helped me see that these are not opposing qualities, but two expressions of the same commitment to truth.

I come to this conversation with hope—not because I believe all tensions will dissolve, but because I believe we can continue to hold them with respect. I hope that by being fully present to you now, I am also being fully present to my own journey. And I hope that in doing this, I am honoring the promise we made to each other: to live with kindness, humility, and fidelity to what we both know is right.
